descriptions.home: See this month's figures and what to do next.
descriptions.transactions: Record sales and payments. Switch between simple entry and the journal grid.
descriptions.inbox: Review and confirm entries suggested from receipt photos and card statements.
descriptions.ledgers: View the journal, general ledger, cash book and bank book.
descriptions.reports: View the trial balance, monthly trends and totals by partner.
descriptions.receivables: Manage recurring sales such as tuition and membership fees, and their payments.
descriptions.closing: Record depreciation and closing adjustments, and get the figures for your blue tax return.
descriptions.master: Manage accounts, descriptions, partners and business-use split rules.
descriptions.data: Import and export CSV or Excel files, and back up or restore your books.
descriptions.settings: Change the display language and color theme.
descriptions.help: How to use the app and what the accounting terms mean, for first-time users.
